name: Aditya Raikwar
now: Now: postdoc at the University of Delaware HCI Lab

both.label: Both
both.headline: I build immersive systems that understand the people using them.
both.sub: I design AR and VR experiences in Unity, instrument them with eye-tracking and EEG, and train models that predict how people think and perform inside them.
both.title: Aditya Raikwar, PhD | Spatial computing and applied ML
both.description: Postdoctoral researcher building AR and VR systems in Unity and the machine learning models that predict how people perform inside them.

ai.label: Applied AI / ML
ai.headline: I turn gaze, brain and behavior data into models that predict how people perform.
ai.sub: End-to-end Python pipelines for physiological and interaction data, from hybrid CNN-GRU networks to fine-tuned, personalized LLMs for human-in-the-loop systems.
ai.title: Aditya Raikwar, PhD | Applied AI and machine learning
ai.description: AI/ML engineer and postdoctoral researcher: predictive models from human behavior data, CNN-GRU networks and personalized LLM pipelines.

xr.label: Spatial computing / XR
xr.headline: I build AR and VR systems in Unity, then measure what they do to people.
xr.sub: Unity (C#) environments that stream EEG and eye-tracking through Lab Streaming Layer to measure cognitive load and engagement, backed by commercial R&D funding.
xr.title: Aditya Raikwar, PhD | Spatial computing and XR engineering
xr.description: Spatial computing engineer and applied research scientist building Unity AR and VR systems measured with real users.
